title: RAW UNREVIEWED: two-organ field order inversion across independent plants
summary: The two f22r upper arrays and two scalar fields lack an organ pointer (IDEA687), so one-page co-presence is inadequate. First find, without using word meanings, a second admitted physical plant leaf with two independently distinguishable upper organ arrays and two separable, complete text fields. Have image-only readers fix whether the array order is inverted relative to f22r and text-only readers fix field order before revealing the pair. A candidate organ assignment predicts that the organ-linked field roles invert with the array identities, whereas a fixed formula order predicts no inversion. If no independent leaf has both arrays and independently bounded fields, record missing capacity; do not infer a reading from the f22r overlap or GDT1091 cup result alone.

design.mechanism: cross-owner permutation of two distinguishable organ arrays and two complete written fields can identify a stable field-to-organ role
design.unit: two physical illustrated leaves, each with two independently bounded text fields and two distinct organ arrays
design.contrast: organ-tracking field inversion versus position- or formula-tracking field order
design.prediction: a predeclared organ-linked reading follows organ identity across a genuine order inversion; fixed field order or absent eligible pair blocks the inference
